gaps.explanation: Statement (trimmed p4) Road Fund column prints Public Works 989,755 + Debt Service: Principal Payments 235,000 + Interest and Fiscal Charges 49,110 + Capital Outlay 260,016 = TOTAL DISBURSEMENTS 1,533,881. The Road Fund budgetary schedule (p6) actual Disbursements 1,249,771 (detail) = 989,755 + 260,016 only; the bond payments belong to the 'Roads - Bond Debt Service Fund', whose budgetary schedule (p9) prints '-' in the Actual column (budget 284,110), so the 235,000 + 49,110 = 284,110 debt service actually paid (statement Total column 235,000 / 49,110) is in no detail line. Fix: add the two printed Road Fund column debt-service rows from p4. Check: 3,986,210 + 235,000 + 49,110 = 4,270,320 = statement total.
